steps.content: A faint roar echoes from outside the window. It seems to be far away, yet very close. Doyle freezes for a moment, then goes back to the delicious meal on the table.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Is that an earthquake outside? It's not serious, is it...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: It's fine. It's probably some construction company doing illegal construction. Not my problem.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Today's our day off. I'm staying with you, come hell or high water.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Ha, how corny.
The TV suddenly turns on, blaring the news extra loudly.

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: ...The incident at the Midsummer Night's Club is worsening... The FAC has urgently deployed counter-Mania troops to slow down the contamination, but Districts 13 and 15 still became affected...

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Ah! What's that wrapped around the club? Is it a... snake? How frightening.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...Pfft, it's just CGI. Don't look at it. I know you don't like horror movies.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What's wrong with TV channels these days? They're always showing this kind of scary **** at dinnertime. They deserve to get ******* bankrupt.
Doyle walks up to the TV and presses the power button, but the TV continues to broadcast scenes from the Midsummer Night's Club.
He frowns and pulls the plug roughly, but it still doesn't turn off. In one corner of the TV, the crack from the fight with ${PlayerName} can still be seen.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...That bastard!
Irritated, Doyle turns around to snatch the remote control from the table, but someone else's hand got to it before him.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Nasha?

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: ...Is that really just CGI?

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: The TV turns on by itself and you can't turn it off... It's because you're worried about the world on the other side, right?

Startled, he takes a deep breath, then takes the remote control from her with trembling hands and shuts off the TV. The screen turns pitch black, leaving behind only the cobweb-like cracks from his outburst, which remain no matter what.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...No. I'm not going there. This is where I care about.
<color=#7683a2>It wasn't easy for me to come back. I won't make the same mistake again.</color>

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Let's eat. You made so much food. We shouldn't let it get cold.
<color=#7683a2>If I leave, I won't ever be able to come back. I won't ever be able to find this warmth again.</color>

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...Nasha, I just want to stay by your side.
I can't lose you again.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: ...You haven't spoken to me like this for a long time.

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: The number of Sleepwalkers is increasing... Panic is spreading amongst the civilians, and there is a severe shortage of security personnel...

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: There have been reports of casualties in many places...

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Look. That's 9th Avenue, isn't it?
She stares at the pitch-black screen as if it is still broadcasting scenes.
9th Avenue... Doyle begins to suffer from shortness of breath.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: 9th Avenue... What a familiar place. Do you remember it?
A vague memory of a woman leaving home alone and heading to 9th Avenue appears in his mind.
He remembered secretly going there many times, wanting to see if she is doing well, and wanting to apologize to her but lacking the courage.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: I wonder if people there are okay. Hope they're not injured.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: If had to face that kind of thing alone, I'd be really scared... Good thing I have you...

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Doyle?

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: ...Are you leaving?
Doyle feels a skull-splitting pain in his head. He grasps Nasha's hands tightly, as if afraid she'll suddenly vanish.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: I... I don't know... I don't know... You're what I want and what matters most to me... I can't bear to lose this place again... I can't bear it...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: ...I know. You're a workaholic.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: You never turn your back on your duty. You're always protecting me and this city while enduring all the pain in silence. That's what attracted me to you in the first place.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Nasha...?
Smiling, she hands him a cup of warm, sweet drink.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Here, have this hangover drink. The incredible inspector must head off with a clear mind.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Go and don't worry. I'll always be here, and... I'll always love you.
These words shake Doyle's whole body and mind like thunder. He wants to hug the woman in front of him and bawl his eyes out.
He didn't really want an apology, repentance, or a rational breakup. All he wanted were those words. All he wanted was to be with her forever.
Her disheartened departure made him realize this. Doyle recalled everything that happened that day...

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Doyle... I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Let's break up. I can't take it anymore...

He remembered that he failed to catch the criminal that day. Once again, he missed dinner, and worked overtime till dawn. When he lost his temper and smashed the TV in front of Nasha, her eyes completely went dark.

There is no such thing as a perfect wife who will be tolerant and understanding forever. The real Nasha is an ordinary person just like him, who faces all sorts of pressure, gets hurt and scared, and feels pain and loneliness.
The real world doesn't have that much joy. To face it together, they must put trust in each other's love, but he hasn't professed it for a long time.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Why are you crying? There, there. I'm here. I'll always be here...
Is Nasha okay? Is she safe? Is she scared? Someone took her phone away. Did she get hurt? Is she toughing out the nightmare as well?
The door opens, leading to boundless darkness, to a reality that Doyle cannot face, and to where she really lives.
Doyle once swore that her happiness mattered more than anything else.

steps.speaker: Nasha
steps.content: Go now. I'll make you something yummy again when you're back.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: All right... I'm leaving...

After this, life will probably become miserable again, but there's nothing to regret about. Doyle takes the hangover drink, gulps it down in one go, then leans over to hug his wife with all his strength.
The warm, soft, nostalgic taste is really like a sweet dream. There will be no more opportunities like this after going back. He can finally say what he needs to.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: I love you.
When the door shuts, the small world behind the door instantly melts into thin air.
